name: Bio Gasthof Post
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Bio Gasthof Post in Mittenwald Nestled in the heart of the Tirol Alps, Bio Gasthof Post invites you to experience authentic mountain hospitality in the charming village…
beschreibung: The Bio Gasthof Post in Mittenwald is a certified organic inn that combines traditional hospitality with environmentally conscious culinary standards. The menu celebrates authentic alpine recipes, utilizing regional organic meats, fresh vegetables, and artisanal dairy products. The historic dining rooms radiate cozy charm, making every meal a comfortable and memorable occasion. An exemplary choice for mindful dining close to the Tyrolean border.
